Product Features

  • Headboard with reading lamp : The reading lamp at the head of the bed is perfectly positioned to provide a pleasant light without disturbing your partner. With its flexible orientation, you can direct the light exactly where you need it so that you can read in peace.
  • Integrated charging function: We also have a built-in charging function that allows you to charge your electronic devices such as smartphones, tablets or directly at the head of the bed. You no longer have to get out of bed to charge your device, saving you time and effort.
  • Made to last You can be sure that you are making an investment in a piece of furniture that will give you many years of enjoyment. The main frame is made of iron and ensures the stability of the bed with a load capacity of 660 lbs. The slatted frames are made of elastic solid wood slats and provide comfortable support for sleep.
  • Hydraulic rod-Great storage space Large bed base below the fold-up slatted frame with plenty of storage space for storing blankets, pillows or bed linen, slatted frame can be easily folded up by lifting cylinder. An Oxford cloth is attached to the bottom of the bed to keep dust out.
  • Detailed Information: This bed has two materials and sizes: beige linen material and grey PU material, and two sizes: 140*200cm and 160*200cm. To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame is shipped in 2 boxes and these can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service. **Please open the non-woven fabric cover on the back of the headboard and the reading lamp accessories
